name: use-window-size
title: useWindowSize
description: Represent the dimension of the window.

types.name: WindowSize
types.description: Represent the dimension of the window.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: - The options for customizing the behavior of the hook (optional).

properties.name: initializeWithValue
properties.description: If `true` (default), the hook will initialize reading the window size. In SSR, you should set it to `false`, returning `undefined` initially.

properties.name: debounceDelay
properties.description: The delay in milliseconds before the state is updated (disabled by default for retro-compatibility).

returnType.name: WindowSize | WindowSize<number>
returnType.description: An object containing the width and height of the window.
